title: PCV 1 Short Circuit Error
detail_of_failure: Short circuit is sensed in the supply pump actuator drive circuit.
machine_effect: • The engine speed does not increase from low idle speed. • Engine output is reduced. • The engine startability degrades. • The common rail fuel pressure is higher than the command value.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CP3 PUMP REGULATOR. 3. Starting switch: ON If the failure code changes from [CA271] to [CA272], the supply pump actuator is defective.

steps.cause: Short circuit or ground fault in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.
If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CP3 PUMP REGULATOR. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and CP3 PUMP REGULATOR. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
